accepted: Right-hand assembly of independent PNG components in layers.json
requirements: Preserve the accepted proportions, expression, contour weight and square pixel clusters.
Create variations by editing the accepted artwork, not by redrawing procedural pixel maps or SVG shapes.
Use independent anatomical front/rear artwork where depth requires it; never horizontally slice a complete picture.
Keep the accepted baseline unchanged. Register variations once in the shared anatomical space, with fixed per-source translation and uniform scale documented in registration.json.
Keep hands and neck integrated into the clothed upper body.
Skin recoloring must not recolor garments, eyes, mouth or outlines.
Visually inspect actual combinations before replacing production assets.
